negative_findings.description: No public source found that ties a specific large MK merchant or chain to a named acquirer with volumes or terminal counts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in mk and en for retail/fuel chain + acquirer announcements returned generic processor marketing (CaSys, Monri) and vendor case studies, but no merchant-level acquiring disclosure or POS-count statement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acquiring share by merchant must therefore be inferred indirectly (checkout redirect hostnames, bank instalment-partner rosters, terms PDFs), not read off any single published source.

negative_findings.description: No official ЈПДП (Public Enterprise for State Roads) toll-payment page was surfaced in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Toll evidence came from Makedonski Telekom's M-TAG page and MK media (Faktor, Sitel, Plusinfo, MMS); the road operator's own site did not appear in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The operator is the authoritative source for toll payment-mix and electronic-lane rollout; its absence leaves the toll segment media-dependent.

negative_findings.description: Session web-search budget was exhausted (200/200) before airlines, e-commerce marketplaces (pazar3, grouper), delivery platforms (Glovo/Wolt MK), A1 Macedonia payment pages, and Ramstore/Tinex/Vero corporate payment pages could be searched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Six mk/en query pairs were executed; the seventh was refused by the budget guard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Several named sub-segments of this coverage cell remain unsearched, so the candidate list under-represents marketplaces, delivery apps and airlines.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) searching was performed, although Albanian is widely used commercially in MK.
negative_findings.result_summary: Run scope specified languages mk,en only; Albanian merchant payment pages (e.g. mënyrat e pagesës) were therefore not covered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchants and municipalities in western MK publish payment information in Albanian; that layer of the acceptance landscape is unmapped.

Add sq terms ('mënyrat e pagesës', 'pagesa me kartelë', 'faturat online') to the next run for merchants, municipalities and transit in western MK.

brief: MK acceptance-side intelligence is fragmented across merchant payment pages, municipal biller portals and supplier marketing, with no aggregated public dataset — but two structural levers make it tractable: nearly every MK webshop names its acquirer/processor on a 'Начини на плаќање' page and redirects to an identifiable gateway host (overwhelmingly CaSys c-Pay, with Monri entering as a challenger), and MK banks publish interest-free instalment merchant rosters that function as de-facto acceptance lists. Public-sector acceptance is concentrated in a handful of high-signal schemes: Skopje transit (Skopska card/app, validators), municipal parking (Parking.MK, POC app, four payment channels), motorway tolling (M-TAG device and M-Card contactless, distributed via Makedonski Telekom), and the two dominant billers EVN and Vodovod Skopje. Fuel forecourts run large closed-loop programmes (Makpetrol Vera, LUKOIL Club) that materially divert volume from open-loop cards, and foreign unattended-payment entrants such as Nayax are visible only through regional business press and vendor case studies. Priority next steps are a scripted gateway-fingerprint crawl of MK merchant checkouts and coverage of the untouched marketplace, delivery, airline and Albanian-language layers.
